_note: My Room door timings. Times in seconds; 'at' and 'span' values are parts (0 to 1) of a fade.

close._note: slam_at: part of the fade-out when the door hits the frame. After it the door rebounds once by rebound (part of fully open) and shakes by shake_px, wobbling shake_freq_x / shake_freq_y radians per unit of the remaining fade.

open._note: span: part of the fade-in the swing takes

swing._note: while the door swings by an angle a (0 shut, 90 degrees open): brightness = shade_base + shade_by_angle * cos(a), height scale = 1 + grow_by_angle * sin(a), the free edge swinging toward the viewer
